name: underwater-routing
question: Which next hop should a node in an underwater acoustic sensor network choose so that the network lives longer?

Q0.label: main
Q0.text: Which next hop or relay should a node in an underwater acoustic sensor network choose to forward data so that network lifetime is extended?
Q0.keywords: next hop relay selection forwarding underwater acoustic sensor network lifetime

Q1.label: subject
Q1.text: Underwater acoustic sensor networks of battery-powered nodes, sinks and autonomous underwater vehicles with long propagation delay and low bandwidth.
Q1.keywords: underwater acoustic sensor network nodes sink auv propagation delay bandwidth battery

Q2.label: approach
Q2.text: Routing protocols and optimisation methods such as depth-based routing, linear or integer programming, game theory and reinforcement learning for relay choice.
Q2.keywords: routing protocol depth based linear integer programming game theory reinforcement learning relay

Q3.label: outcome
Q3.text: Network lifetime, energy per delivered bit, packet delivery ratio, end-to-end delay and void-region avoidance in underwater networks.
Q3.keywords: network lifetime energy per bit packet delivery ratio delay void region

Q4.label: context
Q4.text: Sparse or mobile deployments with ocean currents, multipath, high bit error rates and nodes that cannot be recharged or replaced.
Q4.keywords: sparse mobile deployment ocean current multipath bit error rate non rechargeable battery

Q5.label: comparison
Q5.text: Compared with greedy depth-based forwarding, shortest-path or minimum-hop routing, flooding and random relay choice.
Q5.keywords: baseline greedy depth based forwarding shortest path minimum hop flooding random relay
